name: local-knowledge-codex
description: A local Codex knowledge base that indexes bug fixes, user preferences, facts, decisions, and workflows and recalls them when relevant.

interface.shortDescription: Recall local fixes, user preferences, and project knowledge when needed.
interface.longDescription: Explicitly save knowledge in a local SQLite full-text index and recall relevant scoped records at session start, on user questions, or after real tool failures. Supports bug fixes, preferences, facts, decisions, and workflows; data stays on this computer.
defaultPrompt: Find local knowledge relevant to the current task.
Remember my preferences and apply them automatically when relevant later.
Save a verified bug fix, fact, decision, or workflow.
Migrate legacy local knowledge records and verify the index.
